Be prepared for anything!|[[Santa]] dialogue on Wave 10 ([[Krampus Frosthold]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Frozen''' was an enemy that first appeared in the second phase of [[Krampus Frosthold]] as part of the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. It had above average speed and a fairly low health. It also spawned in large hordes and had a very small defense of 3%, which in most cases was so small it was very unlikely to impact your towers. It also had [[Freeze Immunity]], meaning that it could not be frozen, slowed down or have its defense decreased by freezing towers. It could be spawned by [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]] from its ''Secret Santa'' ability. ==Appearance== The '''Frozen''' was entirely made out of ice. It had a light blue head and arms, with a dark blue translucent torso and legs. It had a snarling face with small glowing white eyes, as well a spiked protrusion on the top of its head. It emitted ice particles and walked with its arms pointed forward. ==Mutation==
